verdict.rationale: Claude is itself the AI assistant, and the evidence shows task delegation in two places. The consumer plans list "Hand off and schedule tasks" alongside web search, file creation and code execution. On the API side, Managed Agents provides a pre-built agent harness for long-running, asynchronous work, with sandboxed code execution and computer use as tools. Community users describe handing long coding tasks to subagents and Claude Code. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how hand-off and scheduling work in the apps (it appears only as a pricing-page bullet), and independent hands-on corroboration of Managed Agents' asynchronous delegation.
